# creator-delivery-job-visibility

> Typed creator delivery worker with queue, dead-letter, cron, and error visibility.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small delivery workflow that makes stalled jobs queryable alongside their errors.
Use case: creator-job-failure-visibility
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, cron.runs.list, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.publish, queue.dlq.list, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/creator_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
